scope.purpose: Machine-readable engineering evidence and operator checklist for the user-controlled iOS App Store submission step.
doesNotAuthorize: changing Apple Developer or App Store Connect settings
using signing or App Store Connect credentials
archiving, signing, uploading, or submitting a build
claiming legal export classification or App Privacy answers are complete
claiming the external human cryptography review is complete

technicalEvidence.claim: The XcodeGen source and generated app Info.plist both declare ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false.
technicalEvidence.operatorFollowUp: Reconfirm the per-build App Store Connect export questionnaire and record the answer; repository flags are not legal advice.

technicalEvidence.claim: The paired transport implements 256-bit AES-GCM content protection over X25519-derived, HKDF-SHA-256 session keys.
Optional rich notification content is opened on-device with a domain-separated X25519/HKDF/AES-GCM envelope.
The readable Live Activity payload is built through a named-field allowlist and uses an opaque per-activity reference rather than a thread id.

requiredText: The opaque per-activity ref, never a threadId

technicalEvidence.operatorFollowUp: Make App Privacy answers match the actual APNs, relay, and distribution architecture; do not infer Data Not Collected from encrypted task content.

technicalEvidence.claim: The app target includes a privacy manifest that disables tracking and declares the UserDefaults required-reason API.
technicalEvidence.operatorFollowUp: Review the App Store Connect questionnaire separately; the privacy manifest is not the questionnaire.

technicalEvidence.claim: The export template targets App Store Connect and keeps the team id as an operator-supplied placeholder.
The archive helper rejects an exported IPA unless aps-environment is production and get-task-allow is false or absent.

requiredText: Expected exported get-task-allow to be false or absent

technicalEvidence.claim: The screenshot helper exercises the offline demo surface without a paired Mac and rejects splash-sized captures.

humanGates.evidenceRequired: Dated review record covering pairing, session keys, replay/nonce handling, notification envelopes, and the readable Live Activity exception.
Saved App Store Connect answers reconciled with relay metadata, APNs tokens and routing fields, Live Activity fields, retention, and any project-operated gateway.
Per-build App Store Connect export-compliance answer and any applicable self-classification record.
Approved app name, debut version, privacy-policy URL, support URL, marketing URL, keywords, screenshots, and final review notes.
Both required recordings below, reviewed for secrets and representative of the submitted build.
Archive/export log, IPA checksum, production APNs entitlement, get-task-allow false or absent, and matching app/extension version-build values.
App Store Connect processing result, selected build, attached review assets, and explicit user approval before submission.

acceptance: show the Remote pairing entry point and QR flow
show the matching six-digit confirmation and explicit human confirmation
show the connected phone and one live run or approval reaching the desktop
show the packaged app version/build without development or HMR tooling
redact bootstrap payloads, keys, tokens, personal identifiers, and private workspace content
show first launch and entry into the offline Try the demo review path
show home, transcript, approval, ensemble, diff, and settings surfaces
show exit from demo and a paired reconnect
show one user-approved remote action continuing on the Mac
show notification permission requested only after pairing if notifications are demonstrated
redact bootstrap payloads, keys, tokens, personal identifiers, and private workspace content
